topic_career_body: Your 10th house, its lord, and the Dasamsa (D10) reveal the direction your career naturally pulls toward. The planet ruling your Midheaven and your current Mahadasha together shape the timing of your most significant professional shifts.
topic_health_body: In Vedic astrology, your ascendant and Moon are the two strongest indicators of physical constitution and vitality. Your Lagna in {{lagna}} and Moon in {{moon}} ({{nakshatra}} nakshatra) shape how your energy naturally runs and how your body tends to recover from stress.
topic_relationship_body: Your Moon shapes your emotional needs in relationships, while Venus shows how you express affection and what draws you to a partner. Your Moon in {{moon}} paired with Venus in {{venus}} points to the kind of connection that genuinely nourishes you.
topic_finance_body: Wealth in Vedic astrology centers on accumulated resources, gains, and Jupiter — the natural significator of abundance. Your Jupiter in {{jupiter}} shows where prosperity tends to flow most naturally for you.

faq_page_q6: Is this AI or a real astrologer?
faq_page_a6: Today, readings are generated by AI grounded in our Vedic astrology reference library (Parashari, KP, and divisional-chart methodology). We're building a marketplace where you'll also be able to consult real, verified astrologers directly — that's coming soon.
faq_page_q7: Do you sell gemstones, rudraksha, or pujas?
faq_page_a7: Not yet. Our gemstone and remedy recommendations are informational, based on your chart. Any future marketplace for gemstones or puja booking will be clearly marked as a separate, optional service.
faq_page_q8: Can I generate a chart for a family member or child?
faq_page_a8: Yes — you can generate a chart for anyone whose birth details you have, including children, as their parent or guardian. See our Privacy Policy for how that information is handled.
faq_page_a9: Most features are currently free. Once paid reports or consultations launch, our Refund & Cancellation Policy explains exactly when a refund applies.
faq_page_q10: Is my birth data sent anywhere outside the app?
faq_page_a10: Your birth details are sent to the AI providers we use (Anthropic Claude and Groq) solely to generate your reading, and to OpenStreetMap for place lookup. Full detail is in our Privacy Policy.

testimonial_1_text: I've consulted astrologers for years but never understood the reasoning. Seeing the actual chart and having the AI explain each placement changed everything. The career report nailed a tension I've been feeling for months.
testimonial_2_text: The Dasha timeline finally made sense to me. I knew I was in a Jupiter period but Star Jyotish showed me exactly how it was interacting with my natal chart. The Ask feature let me go deeper than any static report could.
testimonial_3_text: I was skeptical about AI and astrology together. But the reading was specific — it mentioned my Moon-Saturn square without me asking and connected it directly to patterns in my relationships. That's not generic.
testimonial_4_text: The Navamsa chart reading for my marriage question was impressively detailed. It picked up on the Venus placement and explained why it matters in D9 — in plain language, not jargon.

kundli_div_D1_governs: Overall life, personality, physical body, and destiny. The birth chart itself — the lens through which all other divisional charts are interpreted.
kundli_div_D27_governs: Inner strengths, weaknesses, resilience, and abilities. The D27 gives a nakshatra-level view of your raw energetic capacity, natural talents, and areas of constitutional strength.
kundli_div_D30_governs: Misfortunes, suffering, hidden weaknesses, and karmic challenges. The D30 reveals what difficulties are karmically prescribed and how to work with — rather than against — them.
kundli_div_D60_governs: Past-life karma and the deepest karmic influences shaping this life. The D60 is the subtlest and most powerful chart — used to trace unexplained patterns and fated events across lifetimes.
kundli_div_D10_governs: Career, profession, reputation, and success. The D10 reveals what you are built to create in the public world and which planetary periods accelerate your professional rise.
kundli_div_D24_governs: Education, learning, knowledge, and wisdom. The D24 reveals where your mind excels, which fields of study are karmically supported, and the depth of your intellectual potential.
kundli_div_D9_governs: Marriage, spouse, relationships, dharma, and inner strength. The D9 is considered equally important as the birth chart — a strong Navamsa elevates everything indicated in D1.
kundli_div_D7_governs: Children, fertility, parenting, and creative output. The D7 is consulted for timing of childbirth, fertility questions, and the karmic quality of the parent-child bond.
kundli_div_D12_governs: Parents, ancestors, lineage, and family heritage. The D12 illuminates the karmic quality of the parent-child bond and the patterns you carry forward from your bloodline.
kundli_div_D3_governs: Siblings, courage, initiative, and communication. The D3 reveals the quality of your will, your bonds with siblings, and how you navigate challenges with initiative.
kundli_div_D2_governs: Wealth, income, financial stability, and assets. The D2 shows whether wealth flows through Solar effort or Lunar inheritance — only two signs, so patterns are very clear.
kundli_div_D4_governs: Property, home, vehicles, and inheritance. The D4 is the chart of fixed assets — where you settle, what you accumulate, and the security of your physical foundation.
kundli_div_D16_governs: Vehicles, luxuries, comforts, and happiness. The D16 reveals the ease or difficulty surrounding material pleasures, lifestyle quality, and conveyances in your life.
kundli_div_D6_governs: Diseases, health challenges, enemies, and recovery. The D6 reveals constitutional vulnerabilities, immunity, the nature of illnesses, and the path to recovery.
kundli_div_D8_governs: Longevity, obstacles, hidden events, and deep transformation. The D8 reveals karmic debts that manifest as sudden crises — and the resilience available to meet them.
kundli_div_D20_governs: Spirituality, devotion, and religious practices. The D20 shows the quality of your inner practice and which deity, mantra, or path is naturally aligned with your soul.
kundli_div_D40_governs: Maternal blessings, fortune, and auspicious karma. The D40 reveals fortunate combinations inherited through the maternal lineage and the quality of divine grace available in this life.
kundli_div_D45_governs: Character, ethics, paternal blessings, and virtues. The D45 integrates multiple dimensions of the chart for a holistic view of your essential nature and dharmic path.

about_intro: Star Jyotish was built on a simple idea: Vedic astrology deserves both genuine astronomical rigor and honest, transparent AI — not a generic chatbot wrapped in a zodiac theme, and not vague predictions with no methodology behind them.
about_p_approach1: Every chart on Star Jyotish is calculated using the Swiss Ephemeris — the same astronomical engine used by professional astrology software — covering the full Shodashvarga (all sixteen divisional charts), KP sub-lord analysis, Ashtakavarga, Vimshottari Dasha, and Rajyoga detection. We don't simplify the methodology to make it easier to build; we built the harder version first.
about_p_approach2: Our AI readings are grounded in a structured reference library covering career astrology, gemstones, marriage compatibility, nakshatra characteristics, numerology, and more — rather than a single generic prompt asked to "act like an astrologer." That's a deliberate choice: we'd rather show our work than ask you to trust a black box.
about_p_who: Star Jyotish is built and run by a single founder with a long-standing interest in Vedic astrology — both as a serious area of study and as something worth building well for a modern, bilingual audience in India and beyond. We're an early-stage, independently built platform — not yet a large company — and we'd rather be upfront about that than overstate where we are.
about_p_headed: We're working toward a platform that combines what AI does well — instant, structured, multi-system analysis available in English and Hindi — with real, verified astrologers for the moments where a human conversation matters more than an instant report. If you'd like to follow that progress or get in touch, see our <contact>Contact page</contact>.
about_p_more: For the specifics of how we handle your data, see our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. For what to expect from AI-generated astrology content, see our <disclaimer>Disclaimer</disclaimer>.
